about: Join 11 solui, round 3. Every text box in webview/src/*.tsx has a class here, and every draft scope prefix has a lister. test/solui-r3-inventory.test.mjs fails on a box or a prefix with no entry, and on an entry with no box. Classes: held (the words are held in the draft store or the persisted state and outlive the box), search (a search or filter box), parent (the value is owned above the box, whose owner holds it), transient (typed once for one gesture), outage-deferred (plain state: the words die when the box is drawn anew, the outage, restart and licence class that Kane deferred). The classes were seeded from the code by test/helpers/box-inventory.mjs and judged by hand; a wrong class is a bug in this file.

planrow|.why: words for a row that left the plan are named on the Plan with Copy and Discard

cdraft|.why: words for a box the draft no longer offers are named with Copy and Discard; a draft that is gone altogether leaves its words unlisted (a join item)

calcitem|.why: an item is known by its ref, so a rename looks like a delete: OrphanDrafts asks

calcgroup|.why: round 3: a group known by its ref; a rename the page can pair moves the words, any other leaves them to OrphanDrafts

rowfilter|.why: a row filter is known by role and table name

rolemember|.why: members typed for a role known by name

mcode|.why: two literal listers: mcode|policy| (by table) and mcode|query| (by query id)

spec|.why: spec|buf| is listed by OrphanDrafts; spec|json and spec|struct are singletons (one per model)

startplan|.why: a plan line is known by its name: OrphanDrafts asks

startplan-gone|.why: a retired plan line keeps its words under this prefix and the plan names them (orphanLine)

waive|.why: the lister is computed per page (waive|<holdAs>|), one for each findings list

insight|.why: an insight has an id that survives a rename; pruneGone drops the words of a deleted one

rules|.why: a custom rule has an id that survives a rename; pruneGone drops the words of a deleted one

dataagent|.why: keyed by the agent id and the data source folder, both stable

notes|.why: one Primer per model: there is no object to lose

instructions|.why: one instruction text per model: there is no object to lose

hub|.why: the hub opens the endpoint form again on the first held draft of its row

docs|.why: join 12, J-D1: keyed by a name-based object ref and a section; words typed for an object the assistant renamed or deleted are listed with Keep mine on it (the same section of another object) and Discard

tests-authoring|.why: check|<id> is id-keyed and new|<kind> is a singleton, but mapping|<table> is name-based and has no lister (a join item)

restored|.why: words restored read-only after VS Code restarted are listed by model
